columns.name: Year
columns.description: The calendar year during which the prevailing wage work was performed.

columns.name: Quarter
columns.description: The quarter of the reporting year (Q1, Q2, Q3, or Q4) during which the prevailing wage work was performed.

columns.name: Project County
columns.description: The Illinois county where the public works project is located. Used to identify regional trends in prevailing wage activity.

columns.name: Project Number
columns.description: The project name or number as reported by the contractor. This number is used for tracking and referencing project-specific wage and employment data.

columns.name: Company Name
columns.description: The name of the contractor reporting prevailing wage information for the project.

columns.name: Percent Hispanic or Latino Apprentice
columns.description: Percentage of Hispanic or Latino/a/ex apprentices (workers undergoing structured training in a skilled trade).

columns.name: Percent Hispanic or Latino Journey
columns.description: Percentage of Hispanic or Latino/a/ex journeyworkers (fully qualified skilled tradespeople who have completed apprenticeships).

columns.name: Percent Hispanic or Latino Neither
columns.description: Percentage of Hispanic or Latino/a/ex  employees who are classified as neither journeyworkers nor apprentices in skilled trade positions.

columns.name: Percent Non-Hispanic or Latino Apprentice
columns.description: Percentage of Non-Hispanic or Latino/a/ex apprentices (workers undergoing structured training in a skilled trade).

columns.name: Percent Non-Hispanic or Latino Journey
columns.description: Percentage of Non-Hispanic or Latino/a/ex journeyworkers (fully qualified skilled tradespeople who have completed apprenticeships).

columns.name: Percent Non-Hispanic or Latino Neither
columns.description: Percentage of Non-Hispanic or Latino/a/ex  employees who are classified as neither journeyworkers nor apprentices in skilled trade positions.
